description: SOTA Social Loop 90gg — WR2 editorial KPIs. 3 pillar proxies (audience/authority/lead) + posting heatmap + top posts. Schema: war_room_posts (id, platform, post_external_id, published_at) + post_metrics_history (post_id, horizon_hours, metric_name, metric_value, source) — migration 128_m13_feedback.sql. See docs/runbooks/grafana-sota-setup.md.

panels.title: Audience pillar — saves @ 168h (7d rolling avg)
panels.description: Average saves per post at 168h horizon. Proxy for audience-building per m13_feedback_loop.compute_delta_vs_baseline (pillar=audience → metric=saves).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT date_trunc('day', pmh.collected_at) AS time,
       AVG(pmh.metric_value) AS avg_saves
FROM post_metrics_history pmh
JOIN war_room_posts wrp ON wrp.id = pmh.post_id
WHERE pmh.metric_name = 'saves'
  AND pmh.horizon_hours = 168
  AND pmh.collected_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '14 days'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Authority pillar — reach @ 72h (7d rolling avg)
panels.description: Average reach at 72h. Proxy for authority per m13_feedback_loop (pillar=authority → metric=reach).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT date_trunc('day', pmh.collected_at) AS time,
       AVG(pmh.metric_value) AS avg_reach
FROM post_metrics_history pmh
JOIN war_room_posts wrp ON wrp.id = pmh.post_id
WHERE pmh.metric_name = 'reach'
  AND pmh.horizon_hours = 72
  AND pmh.collected_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '14 days'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Lead pillar — click_through @ 24h (7d rolling avg)
panels.description: Average click_through at 24h. Proxy for lead per m13_feedback_loop (pillar=lead → metric=click_through).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT date_trunc('day', pmh.collected_at) AS time,
       AVG(pmh.metric_value) AS avg_click_through
FROM post_metrics_history pmh
JOIN war_room_posts wrp ON wrp.id = pmh.post_id
WHERE pmh.metric_name = 'click_through'
  AND pmh.horizon_hours = 24
  AND pmh.collected_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '14 days'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Posting heatmap — WITA hour × day-of-week (30d)
panels.description: Cadence validation vs 06_cadence_engine.json hypothesis (07/12/19 WITA optimal). Reads war_room_posts.published_at.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT to_char(wrp.published_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Makassar', 'FMDay') AS day_of_week,
       EXTRACT(HOUR FROM wrp.published_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Makassar')::int AS hour_wita,
       COUNT(*) AS post_count
FROM war_room_posts wrp
WHERE wrp.published_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days'
GROUP BY 1,2
ORDER BY 1,2

panels.title: Top 10 posts last 7d — latest likes+comments (engagement abs)
panels.description: Post leaderboard. For each post, pivot the latest likes/comments from post_metrics_history and sum. Used in M13 weekly report context.

targets.rawSql:
WITH latest AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (post_id, metric_name)
         post_id, metric_name, metric_value, collected_at
    FROM post_metrics_history
   WHERE metric_name IN ('likes','comments','saves','reach')
   ORDER BY post_id, metric_name, collected_at DESC
),
pivot AS (
  SELECT post_id,
         MAX(CASE WHEN metric_name='likes'    THEN metric_value END) AS likes,
         MAX(CASE WHEN metric_name='comments' THEN metric_value END) AS comments,
         MAX(CASE WHEN metric_name='saves'    THEN metric_value END) AS saves,
         MAX(CASE WHEN metric_name='reach'    THEN metric_value END) AS reach
    FROM latest
   GROUP BY post_id
)
SELECT wrp.post_external_id AS ig_id,
       wrp.platform,
       wrp.published_at,
       p.likes, p.comments, p.saves, p.reach,
       COALESCE(p.likes,0) + COALESCE(p.comments,0) + COALESCE(p.saves,0) AS engagement_abs
FROM war_room_posts wrp
JOIN pivot p ON p.post_id = wrp.id
WHERE wrp.published_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days'
ORDER BY engagement_abs DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10
